Twenty-seven [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after his [[Battle of Belazura|exile]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] landed on a [[Unidentified dead red moon|barren red moon]]; using the data he had compiled over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Soresh established an '''outpost.''' [[1 ABY/Legends|Sometime after the]] [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Soresh [[Mission to Nyemari]] lured the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to his outpost in an attempt to [[Project Omega|turn him into an]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] by threatening the [[Starship/Legends|colony vessel]] [[Endeavor (Arkanian starship)|''Endeavor'']]. Skywalker and his [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|companions]] were captured and held for two weeks. Skywalker later betrayed Soresh.

The outpost was destroyed during the [[Battle of the Sixela system]] after Soresh launched [[resonance torpedo]]es at the sun, though his Rebel prisoners escaped.

==Characteristics==
By the time the facility was [[Battle of the Sixela system|destroyed]], the outpost consisted of a small cluster of [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]] buildings. [[Turbolaser/Legends|Turbolasers]] stood over the hostages, who were placed in electrified pens. The long-extinct indigenous population built underground tunnels, which [[Rezi Soresh]] used to a great extent. It had been established on the equator of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. The outpost also had a command center complete with a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]].

==History==
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] fled [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], he spent twenty-seven [[Standard day/Legends|days]] on the run. He ended his journey by settling in the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]], choosing a [[Unidentified dead red moon|moon]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Unidentified planet (dead red moon)|third planet]]. As an Imperial bureaucrat, Soresh had access to a lot of data, and he used that data to bribe or blackmail his way back to power, and established this outpsot on the barren red rock of the moon. He was also able to waylay the [[Starship/Legends|colony vessel]] [[Endeavor (Arkanian starship)|''Endeavor'']] to use as hostages in his plan to [[Project Omega|turn]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] into a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. Skywalker and his [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|companions]] arrived at Soresh's outpost after Soresh [[Mission to Nyemari|contacted Skywalker to set a deadline before executing the hostages]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] landed his starship the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] near the outpost and met a [[Rezi Soresh (impostor)|hooded man]]. Two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] strafed the compound, destroying the turbolasers aimed at the hostages; this angered the hooded man, and he raised his blaster at Solo but was shot instead. The X-wings landed and Skywalker and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] disembarked. A series of [[Mine/Legends|mines]] started exploding amongst the hostages. The Rebel operatives rushed to assist and were ambushed by Soresh and his mindwiped guards.

Soresh spent the next two weeks torturing Skywalker and putting him through tests; one of these tests backfired and Skywalker's friends escaped, although Skywalker remained behind. Soresh had used the resources available to him to acquire [[resonance torpedo]]es from the hidden [[Maw Installation]]; these dangerous weapons could turn a [[Star/Legends|star]] into a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. Soresh planned on launching the torpedoes at the system's star after luring Darth Vader, along with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] to the system, and destroying both. When the time came to launch the torpedoes from the command center, Skywalker betrayed Soresh, but Soresh was able to launch the torpedoes and escape. When the chain reaction in the stars started, the opposing fleets withdrew. Soresh tried to kill Skywalker, but was shot by Solo. The outpost and everything in the system were obliterated when the star exploded.

==Behind the scenes==
This outpost appears in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] novel ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''. The moon it is situated on was first said to orbit the third planet, and later the sixth.
